_doc: Technical QC thresholds (brief s20). Grain/fuzz: 1.2 x the maximum observed on Peach 0087 in the geometry-only arms J and G (which never change texture): grain max 1.29, fuzz max 1.39. J/G therefore pass grain/fuzz by construction; those two flags are informative only for texture-editing arms. Other thresholds are fixed a priori. Technical QC is NOT biological validation.
